busy.miss: Distance from the aim point: {value} km

error.target:maneuver: The maneuver is not in the flight. Make sure that its date is between the start and the end of the flight.
error.target:encounter: The flight has no hyperbolic approach to this body after the maneuver.
error.target:path: The propagation to the maneuver stopped. Examine the flight on the Mission screen.
error.target:order: The closest approach must be after the maneuver and after all maneuvers that follow it.
error.target:converge: The targeter did not find a solution. Set an aim point nearer to the aim point of the flight, or use an earlier maneuver.

flight.target.title: Maneuver from the targeter
flight.target.method: The targeter propagates the flight from the maneuver to the approach of the body. It changes the three components of the maneuver with a damped Newton method until the approach hyperbola has the aim point. If the time is free, each step is the smallest change of the maneuver.
flight.target.limit: The calculation stops when the error of the aim point is less than 20 m or 1 × 10⁻⁶ of the body radius. If numerical noise prevents a smaller error, the calculation accepts 20 times this value. The application then propagates the flight again: the Effect table shows the aim point of that flight. The maneuver is an impulse.

flight.elements.title: Osculating orbit of the spacecraft
flight.elements.method: The engine converts the position and the velocity of the spacecraft relative to the body to two-body elements. The gravitational parameter is the value of the body and its moons.
flight.elements.limit: Osculating elements are exact for the state at that time. They change with time because other bodies pull the spacecraft.

flight.force.title: Effect of a force on the flight
flight.force.method: The application propagates the flight again with one change of the force model: it removes a force that the model has, or it adds a force that the model does not have. The value is the distance between the two paths at the same time.
flight.force.limit: The value shows the size of the effect of that force for this flight. It is not an error of the flight. The engine has no model for some forces: the Propagation screen gives the list.

item.target_bplane: B-plane distance and periapsis radius of an exact hyperbola
item.target_closure: Targeter: distance from the aim point after a new propagation
item.target_closureInsertion: Targeter, encounter with an orbit insertion: distance from the aim point after a new propagation
item.target_closureDistant: Targeter, flyby of Jupiter at 137 radii (Cassini): distance from the aim point after a new propagation

maneuvers.title: Maneuvers
maneuvers.intro: This screen shows the maneuvers of the flight. You can change them, add a maneuver, and aim a maneuver at an encounter.
maneuvers.noMission: No mission is open. Open a mission, or make a flight from a state vector.
maneuvers.noFlight: This mission has no flight. Calculate the flight first.
maneuvers.select: Show the orbit before and after this maneuver
maneuvers.add: Add a maneuver at the time of the view
maneuvers.tableNote: Each maneuver is an impulse. V, N, B: along the velocity, along the orbit normal, and V × N. R, T, N: along the position, N × R, and along the orbit normal. X, Y, Z: the axes of the frame. A local frame uses the state relative to the reference body. If you change the frame, the application converts the components: the velocity change stays the same.
maneuvers.manualNote: You changed the maneuvers of this flight. A new flight calculation from the plan replaces your changes.
maneuvers.noPropellant: The maneuvers use {need} kg of propellant. The spacecraft has {have} kg.
maneuvers.orbit: Orbit about {body} before and after maneuver {n}
maneuvers.orbitTitle: Orbit before and after a maneuver
maneuvers.orbitSelect: Select the number of a maneuver in the table.
maneuvers.orbitNone: The time of this maneuver is not in the flight on the screen. Apply the changes first.
maneuvers.distance: Distance from the center of the body
maneuvers.orbitNote: Two-body elements of the state relative to the reference body. Frame of the inclination: {frame}. The values use the flight on the screen and the components in the table.
maneuvers.propellantNote: Rocket equation with a specific impulse of {isp} s. Mass with no propellant: {dry} kg. Propellant mass: {prop} kg. You can change these values on the Mission screen.
maneuvers.target: Aim a maneuver at an encounter
maneuvers.targetNote: The targeter changes the three components of one maneuver. The flight then goes through the aim point that you set in the B-plane of the encounter.
maneuvers.targetNoEncounter: The flight has no closest approach after this maneuver.
maneuvers.targetNoManeuver: The flight has no maneuver. Add a maneuver first.
maneuvers.timeFreeCell: Free: smallest change of the maneuver
maneuvers.targetNotHyperbola: The approach orbit at this encounter is not a hyperbola. The B-plane is not applicable to it.
maneuvers.targetBelow: This aim point gives a path below the surface of the body.
maneuvers.targetAxes: B-plane axes: S is the direction of the approach asymptote, T = S × (north pole of the ecliptic), R = S × T. The angle and the altitude are a different form of B·T and B·R.
maneuvers.targetDone: The targeter changed maneuver {n} from {before} to {after} in {iterations} iterations. Distance from the aim point at {body}: {miss} km.
maneuvers.effectNone: The flight has no closest approach.
maneuvers.effectNote: Each change is the value of the flight on the screen minus the value of the flight before the last change. Click a row to set the time of the view.
maneuvers.effectEnd: The position at the end of the flight moved by {value} km.
